title: DASH age/insulin level esthetic bug
symptom: On the DASH pod interface, the label shows 'Age:Insulin level' when 'Age:' should be removed. Also, the user requests eliminating all battery information for DASH because the battery changes with each pod, while battery info for EROS should remain as it reports OL battery info.
fix: The issue is fixed in PR https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/1264. The battery request is on the developer's list, but first a refactor of the status light (PR #1200) must be merged, after which it is a small change.
